title: Border and Cipher Revisited
author: Ada Brightwater
blurb: Orsen Winterbourne, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
